# Daybook

> Daybook is a free, private, offline-ready personal work diary and task log. Log daily tasks in seconds, organise them into optional projects, see analytics, and export Excel, PDF or CSV reports.

## Key facts
- Quick add parses dates, hours, #module, !priority, ~project and due dates from one line.
- Views: day, week, month, Kanban board (with WIP limits per project) and table.
- Projects are optional; tasks can be moved between projects or left without one.
- Reports: Excel (multi-sheet with formulas), PDF, CSV, Markdown, standup generator.
- Data is stored in the browser (localStorage); accounts are local to the device.
